paras: Dibamus vorisi is a species of legless lizard in the family Dibamidae. The species is endemic to Borneo.
The specific name, vorisi, is in honor of American herpetologist Harold Knight Voris (born 1940) of the Field Museum of Natural History.
The preferred natural habitat of D. vorisi is forest.
D. vorisi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 9 cm (3.5 in). The tail is short, about 14% SVL in males, and only about 6% SVL in females.
